hooks.name: Commit and push after each spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, reminds the agent to run tests, update PROJECT.md and KIRO_USAGE.md, then commit and push so every task has a restore point.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Run the tests for the package you changed. If they pass: update the task status in PROJECT.md and add a short note to docs/KIRO_USAGE.md, stage the changed files by name (never .env or secrets), commit as "Task N: <what changed>", and run `git push origin main`. If tests fail, do not commit; report the failure instead. Never force-push.
